gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was net adverse claims development of GBP 34.5 million on the 2013 and prior years and GBP 1.3 million on the 2014 year of account.
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of its gross claims reserves by GBP 71.180 million in 2015, representing a 52.8% increase over the opening reserves. This adverse development was primarily driven by a material strengthening of claims reserves for the 2013 and prior years, and to a lesser extent the 2014 year of account. The strengthening followed an independent review of open claims and was particularly notable in professional indemnity, directors and officers, and medical malpractice classes of business, attributed to a significant increase in incurred claims position and complex litigation trends. The uncertainty surrounding these claims led the Board to keep the 2013 year of account open.

gemini-2.5-flash.data_quality_notes: The 'exact_reserve_text' describes net adverse claims development, while the 'prior_year_development_gbp_m' is the gross figure from the technical provisions note, which is significantly higher. gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: During 2015 the syndicate materially strengthened its claims reserves, primarily for the 2013 and prior years. The strengthening was driven by significant increases in incurred claims on professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice business (the bulk of the portfolio), resulting in a gross prior-year reserve strengthening of GBP 71.18m (52.8% of opening gross claims reserves). The managing agent and independent claims consultants reviewed open claims and adjusted IBNR and reserving methodologies, producing the adverse development.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the gross prior-year movement are taken directly from the technical provisions (Note 17) and the 'Changes for prior years' line (gross insurance liabilities). Narrative also reports net adverse development (GBP 34.5m) which is net of reinsurance; the gross movement used here (GBP 71.18m) is the authoritative gross figure. The report does not allocate the gross prior-year strengthening to statutory class names, only describing impacted classes (PI, D&O, medical malpractice); allocation by LOB is therefore inferred and not quantified.
